notes: The far range of Map1_Skyline.glb re-cut for Roblox, whose parts may be at most 2,048 studs long: the same 44,000 triangles (the generator's build_skyline), regrouped into tiles on the world's own axes so that no part's bounding box is over 2,000 studs on any axis. The eight assets keep the names Map1_Layout.json places at the map centre. Parts: M1_Skyline_<sector>_<tile>_<role>; one flat colour per part (rgb, also the part's material colour in the GLB): the colour that sector's role has in Map1_Skyline.glb. No vertex colours, no textures, flat-shaded, single-sided, every triangle faces up, which is toward the arena. Every asset of this file is modelled in world space with its pivot at the map centre (0, 0, 0): place each at position (0, 0, 0) with yaw 0. In the file the assets stand in a row along +X, as in every other GLB of this project; 'origin' is each asset's pivot in the file. Each part also carries 'position' and 'size': the centre and the extent of its bounding box in Roblox world space once its asset stands at the map centre. A MeshPart's Position is its bounding box's centre, so a part is in place when its Position equals 'position' and its Size equals 'size' (after the importer's own turn about Y has been undone, as for every other asset). Set RenderFidelity to Precise: neighbouring parts share an edge exactly, and a part simplified on its own could open a crack along it. CanCollide, CanQuery, CanTouch and CastShadow are false; the model is Persistent.

tiling.method: columns of equal width along X, each cut into equal slabs along Z; a triangle goes where its centroid lies; a part of under 24 triangles joins the same role's part in a neighbouring tile when the joint box still fits

notes: One upload per file through Open Cloud POST /assets/v1/assets (creator user 5458010221), 2026-11-15 local (2026-11-16 UTC). Never re-upload a file listed here; reuse its id.

No textures: one flat colour per part, set by ServerStorage.WorldGen.Map1.Assets from this manifest. The raw insert lives in ServerStorage.MeshImports.Map1_<set> (never edit it); templates in ServerStorage.WorldAssets.Map1.
